name: vue-project-stack
description: Use this skill when working in a Vue project that uses the wider Lewis Howles stack. Covers the chosen tools (Vue 3 with script setup, Tailwind, Vitest, Bun, Gitflow, GitHub Pages) with the *why* for each so suggestions can flag outdated choices, plus the @lewishowles/helpers and @lewishowles/components libraries that replace common packages.
when: When working in Vue + Bun + Vitest + Tailwind + Gitflow stack
do-not-use-when: Choosing or inspecting component-library options, examples, props, slots, or composition patterns
